objectives.text: Talk to the Wounded Man.
Equip your starter weapon.
Loot the Large Chests; equip useful items and skills.

target.label: Large Chest
target.guidance: Follow the Riverbank route and open the tutorial chests.

objectives.text: Kill The Bloated Miller.
Enter Clearfell Encampment behind the boss.

target.label: Clearfell Encampment
target.guidance: The entrance opens beyond The Bloated Miller.

objectives.text: Talk to Renly and take the level 1 Skill Gem.
Enter Clearfell.
Talk to Farrow to start The Runeseeker.
objectives.note:
0.5 New Farrow is the new league NPC. Meeting him here only starts the Runeseeker quest — the Verisium Anvil unlocks at the end of the Act 1 chain (collect 3 Runestones → Lost Catacombs → return to Clearfell). Runeforging then lets you spend Verisium to add Runic Ward , a regenerating layer that absorbs damage at 1 life (free on sub-55 bases; trades some defence for Ward above that). Full detail in the Crafting Codex.
Runeforging ladder One tier unlocks per act: Act 1 Armour Runeforging → Act 2 Runic Inscriptions → Act 3 Unique Runeforging → Act 4 Ancient Runes.

objectives.text: Kill Beira of the Rotten Pack in the north.

target.label: Beira of the Rotten Pack
target.guidance: Search the northern edge of Clearfell.

objectives.text: Enter the optional Mud Burrow.
Kill The Devourer.
objectives.note:
A waypoint sits right next to Mud Burrow ; the bridge onward leads to The Grelwood
After the kill, talk to Renly in town for a Support Gem Lv1

objectives.text: Open the Abandoned Stash inside the Mysterious Campsite.

target.label: Abandoned Stash
target.guidance: Look for the Mysterious Campsite landmark.

objectives.text: Enter The Grelwood.
Find, summon, and talk to Una.
Activate The Grelwood waypoint.
Enter Grim Tangle, activate its waypoint, then return.
Enter The Red Vale, activate its waypoint, then return.
Kill Gerung, the Brambleghast.
Find the hut with the cauldron and collect its rewards.
objectives.note: Areagne is the hardest early fight — frost bomb chills her, makes it manageable

objectives.text: Enter The Red Vale.
Activate all three Obelisks of Rust and loot each Runed Girdle.
Kill The Rust King after the final obelisk.
objectives.note: Kite mobs under his feet for AoE damage uptime

objectives.text: Return to Clearfell Encampment.
Talk to Renly and collect the Runed Spikes.
Travel to The Grelwood.
Activate all three Runic Seals.
Talk to Una.
Return to Clearfell Encampment.
Talk to Una.
Travel to Grim Tangle.
Kill Ervig, the Rotted Druid.
Enter Cemetery of the Eternals.
Talk to Lachlann the Lost.
Open the Ancient Ruins sarcophagus near the checkpoint.
Enter the Mausoleum of the Praetor.
Kill Draven and take his Key Piece.
Find and open the Forgotten Riches hidden cache.
objectives.note: Find the hidden switch to open the cache

objectives.text: Enter the Tomb of the Consort.
Kill Asinia and take her Key Piece.
Find and open the Haunted Treasure secret.
Open the Memorial Gate next to Lachlann.
Kill Lachlann and loot the ring.
Enter Hunting Grounds and activate its waypoint.
Return to Clearfell Encampment.
Talk to Finn.
Talk to Una.
Talk to The Hooded One.
objectives.note: Revival The Hooded One revives upon return — Identify is now available

objectives.text: Complete Farrow's encounter for Runestone 2 of 3.
Talk to Delwyn.
objectives.note: Delwyn is a bit further into the zone than Farrow

objectives.text: Kill The Crowbell.
objectives.note: Watch slam attacks — can one-shot. Boss flees at low HP, kite carefully

objectives.text: Enter Freythorn, activate its waypoint, then return.
Enter Ogham Farmlands, activate its waypoint, then return.
Complete the optional small ritual away from the zone entrance.
Travel to Freythorn.
Activate all three small Ritual Altars.
objectives.note: Big altar's smoke tendrils point to the small altars — follow them

objectives.text: Activate the big altar and kill The King in the Mists.
objectives.note:
Aoife spawns in this fight (Druid class only?) and drops a spirit gem
Phase 2: dodge totem summons + curses (stand still vs keep moving differ)

objectives.text: Cleanse the optional Ominous Altars.
Claim a Ruby, Sapphire, or Topaz Charm from Finn.
Travel to Ogham Farmlands.
Open Una's Lute Box in the house near the checkpoint.
objectives.note:
Deliver to Una in town for the reward
0.5 Quest Runeseeker — Runestone 3 of 3 (this zone, in a crop field). With all three found: return to Grelwood and summon Farrow at the Tree of Souls → run the Lost Catacombs → grab the Liquid Verisium at the end → return to Clearfell to unlock the Verisium Anvil .

objectives.text: Kill the rare dogs in the crop circle.
Enter Ogham Village.
Collect the Smithing Tools in the house (first character only).
objectives.note: Follow the cobble road to the smithing house

objectives.text: Open the Blacksmith's Chest in the same house.
Kill The Executioner.
objectives.note: Fight is mostly in the north of the village

objectives.text: Go upstairs, pull the lever, and talk to Leitis.
Enter The Manor Ramparts.
Pull the rope on the hanging man near the checkpoint.
objectives.note: Confirm Lvl 10 flask + Lvl 11 chest piece before entering Manor — much safer

objectives.text: Enter Ogham Manor.
Kill Candlemass on the first floor.
objectives.note: Usually after the first walkway (when you first see the Count), sometimes earlier — drops Essence + double-res belt

objectives.text: Go downstairs and kill Geonor.
objectives.note:
Act I boss.
Manor descent: take each floor heading the opposite direction from the floor above — retrace how you crossed the walkway
Phase 2: dodge roll under his sword. Frost bomb at start of Phase 2 chills him

objectives.text: Return to Clearfell Encampment.
Talk to all NPCs and collect the end-of-act rewards.
Talk to The Hooded One and choose â€œFollow the Beast's Trailâ€.
objectives.note: Act I Complete — proceed to Act II
